Our little solution actually has a fatal flaw: it causes an infinite loop.
The problem here is that fetch() runs every time the component renders, in a never-ending cycle:

items: fetch() runs and the response calls the setEntries() function
fetch() runs again — and the loop never stops

blocks.content: So let's start thinking about how to solve this next.
